name: Anarchist synthesis
summary: The anarchist synthesis is an organisational doctrine of the 1920s, mainly Voline and Sebastien Faure, holding that anarchist communism, anarcho-syndicalism and individualist anarchism are complementary rather than rival currents. It shares the anarchist aim of abolishing the state and capitalist exploitation through social revolution, but leaves the economic form of the free society open and favours one loosely federated, pluralist anarchist organisation over a single-line party.
scope: The 'united anarchism' of Voline (Nabat declaration, Synthesis article) and Faure's 1927 The Anarchist Synthesis, with its precursors Tarrida del Marmol's anarchism without adjectives, Malatesta and Nettlau, set against the 1926 Dielo Trouda Platform. Positions on issues those texts never address (religion, gender, environment, immigration) are inferred from general anarchist principles and marked low confidence. Excludes anarcho-capitalism and the platformist model.

keyFigures.name: Voline
keyFigures.role: Russian anarchist who drafted the Nabat statutes and developed the synthesis against the Platform.

keyFigures.name: Sébastien Faure
keyFigures.role: French anarchist who set out his own version in The Anarchist Synthesis (1927).

keyFigures.name: Fernando Tarrida del Mármol
keyFigures.role: Coined 'anarchism without adjectives' in 1889, a precursor of the synthesis.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Anarchists want care available to all through mutual aid and federated communes, but a state-provided service conflicts with abolishing the state; inferred, not discussed in sources.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Synthesists aim to abolish the wage system through revolution and syndicalist action, so a state-set wage floor is a reform they would not prioritise; inferred.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Faure's libertarian-communist current pools production and exchange, though the individualist current tolerates exchange; the market-over-government claim is inferred as mostly rejected.

public-ownership.rationale: Nabat's communist basis implies collective ownership run by producers and communes, not state ownership, so state-run public industry is rejected in favour of non-state commons.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Communist currents see taxation as reform of a system they want to overthrow, individualists oppose taxation outright; the synthesis offers no common line.

unions-good.rationale: Faure says anarchists should treat syndicalism as one of the levers of their action, while warning that unions alone adapt and turn conservative.

property-fundamental.rationale: Faure presents the pooling of the means of production as the libertarian-communist aim and attacks capitalist exploitation, so private property as an overriding right is rejected.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Anarchists attack capitalist power but would abolish rather than have the state regulate corporations; inferred from anti-statism.

cut-welfare.rationale: Synthesists distrust state welfare as paternalist yet oppose attacking the poor; the dependency framing is a liberal-right one they would reject, inferred.

worker-ownership.rationale: Voline's Nabat formula makes syndicalism the method of revolution and communism the basis of the new society, implying producers collectively control workplaces within a wider commons.

surveillance-ok.rationale: SEP describes anarchism as sceptical of state authority, putting the burden of proof on it; security surveillance by the state would not meet that burden.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Faure affirms every individual's right to full fulfilment of their needs, which supports adult freedom over drugs; inferred.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Anarchists distrust state censorship although they oppose bigotry; inferred from opposition to state coercion.

strong-leader.rationale: Faure's aim is doing away with every authoritarian institution, and Voline gives the masses, not leaders, the revolution.

state-harmful.rationale: Faure holds that the state and all institutions that result from it must be abolished, and anarchism opposes every authoritarian institution.

limit-guns.rationale: Anarchists object to a state monopoly on arms and Faure wants an armed insurrection, though gun control as such is not discussed; inferred.

empower-police-military.rationale: Police and army are core authoritarian institutions of the state that the synthesis seeks to abolish.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Inferred from individual liberty and the right to fulfilment; sources do not address sex work.

decide-locally.rationale: The synthesis is a federation of autonomous groups that keeps members' autonomy, extended in anarchist thought to free local association.

rehabilitation.rationale: SEP reports Kropotkin's view of prisons as schools for crime, which favours non-punitive approaches; inferred.

traditional-family.rationale: SEP notes anarchists criticise patriarchal family hierarchy while valuing cooperative family bonds; the foundation-of-society claim is mostly rejected.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Inferred from individual liberty; anarchists would add that marriage should not need state sanction.

abortion-legal.rationale: Inferred from individual self-determination in every domain, as in Faure's right to complete fulfilment.

more-religion-public.rationale: Anarchists reject political authority of any kind, though SEP notes a minority of religious anarchists; inferred for the mainstream.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Inferred from opposition to domination; sources do not discuss racial reparation.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Inferred from anarchist critique of patriarchal hierarchy; not discussed in the sources.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: SEP reports anarchist doubt that national borders and nation-states are sacred; preserving national culture is not a goal.

gradual-change.rationale: Faure calls the Social Revolution an inevitable and decisive assault on the existing order rather than a gradual change respecting its institutions.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Inferred from rejection of borders as state artifacts.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: SEP notes anarchist criticism of world government; inter-state bodies like the UN are state structures.

free-trade.rationale: The communist and syndicalist currents oppose capitalist exchange; claim that free trade benefits everyone is not adopted, inferred.

nation-first.rationale: Anarchists treat nation-states as illegitimate, and the synthesis is internationalist in outlook.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Anarchists oppose state military action though they support solidarity with the oppressed; inferred.

open-borders.rationale: SEP cites the view that nothing is sacred about national borders; a stateless society has no border control.

limit-growth.rationale: Eco-anarchist currents favour limits while communists often welcome abundance; sources do not settle it.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Eco-anarchists want radical change, but the statement asks for government action, which anarchists reject; split.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Anarchists are divided between technological optimism and anti-industrial currents; no common stand.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Eco-anarchist and anti-state suspicion of centralised, state-run industry; inferred.

revolution-justified.rationale: Faure calls the Social Revolution inevitable and decisive and asks for active, brutal participation of the working masses.

experts-over-public.rationale: Voline stresses that the masses make the revolution and anarchists only guide by example, rejecting rule by a specialised elite.

central-planning.rationale: Voline's synthesis rests on federated free organisation, with only free, natural, technical centralisation, which excludes state planning.

socialized-markets.rationale: Anarchism without adjectives leaves the economic form open to experiment, so worker-owned markets are acceptable to many; communists would disagree.

land-value-tax.rationale: A state fiscal reform that leaves the state intact; synthesists do not endorse it, inferred.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Communists would abolish inheritance as part of expropriation while individualists reject taxes; no shared position.

basic-income.rationale: State-granted income conflicts with abolishing the state, though the end of wage dependence is welcome; inferred.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: State protection of national industry is nationalist and statist; inferred.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Faure rejects the state and its institutions; investment is to be decided by producers' and communal bodies.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Individualist and mutualist currents favour small holdings while communists pool the means of production; the synthesis keeps both.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Voline's Nabat names communism as the organisational basis of the new society, implying an end to wage labour; individualists may differ.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Abolishing the state removes central banks, but leaving money to the market clashes with the communist current; split.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-recognised bodies fixing wages and prices are an authoritarian institution of the kind Faure says anarchism abolishes.

one-party-rule.rationale: Voline accused the Platform's centralised party of leading to a state, comparing it to Bolshevism, and synthesists reject any ruling party.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Faure aims to abolish every authoritarian institution, a hereditary head of state being a clear case.

democracy-best.rationale: SEP presents anarchism as sceptical of all coercive government, including majoritarian democracy, though some favour unanimous direct democracy.

direct-votes.rationale: Direct participation in decisions is closer to anarchist practice than representation, though anarchists reject majority rule binding all; inferred.

workers-councils.rationale: Voline's syndicalist method and federated free organisation point to producers' bodies in place of parliaments, though anarchists deny any political power as such.

right-to-secede.rationale: The synthesis is built on voluntary federation and autonomy of members, which implies freedom to leave.

natural-rulers.rationale: Faure opposes every authoritarian institution, and the claim that some are born to rule is the opposite of anarchist equality.

political-violence-never.rationale: Faure demands the masses' brutal and persistent participation in the revolutionary assault, and SEP notes Malatesta called violence a necessary evil.

war-builds-character.rationale: Inferred from internationalism and hostility to the military and state.

separate-church-state.rationale: Anarchists would end the state altogether, which includes ending its ties with religion; religion itself is not addressed in Faure.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Inferred from rejection of state law and authority; SEP notes only a minority of religious anarchists.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Individualist strands may accept private provision, but the communist and syndicalist currents reject profit-based force; inferred.

military-superiority.rationale: An armed state seeking superiority is a core authoritarian institution Faure seeks to abolish.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Anarchist internationalism rejects ethnic nation-states; inferred.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Faure frames capitalism as exploitation answered by a social revolution of the working masses, close to a class view of change.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Communism as organisational basis implies distribution by need and economic equality; inferred.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Inferred from opposition to state domination and support for local control.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Inferred from anti-imperial, anti-state stance; not discussed.

civilizational-union.rationale: Union of states by religion or civilization is statist; inferred.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Faure's individualist current celebrates personal fulfilment while the communist current stresses solidarity; the synthesis holds both.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Faure affirms the right of every individual to complete fulfilment, so community duty is not placed above it; inferred.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: SEP notes green and eco-anarchist strands; not a core of the 1920s synthesis.

limit-population.rationale: State population control conflicts with individual freedom; inferred.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Anarcho-primitivism is an extreme, minority strand per SEP, while the synthesis builds on syndicalism and communism of industrial society.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Sources do not address it; adherents are split between optimists and sceptics.

human-enhancement.rationale: Inferred from individual liberty and the right to full self-development.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Rule by algorithm is another authority over people; inferred from anti-authoritarianism.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Inferred from distrust of state surveillance.

restore-past-order.rationale: The synthesis seeks social revolution against the existing authoritarian order, not restoration of one.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Voline stresses flexibility and rejects any current claiming to be sole truth, though anarchists do hold firm principles.

direct-action.rationale: Faure wants syndicalism as a lever of action and active insurrection; SEP lists direct action as the anarchist method.

means-match-ends.rationale: SEP cites Franks that anarchist means should match anarchist ends of liberation and autonomy, though Faure also accepts brutal revolutionary means.

return-to-foraging.rationale: SEP places anarcho-primitivism at the extreme; synthesis builds on industrial syndicalism.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Not discussed by Voline or Faure; communists and syndicalists disagree on it.

distribute-by-need.rationale: SEP cites Kropotkin's anarchist communism with the motto all for all, which Faure's communist current represents.

production-for-use.rationale: Faure attacks capitalist exploitation and wants the means of production pooled, implying production for needs.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Faure describes capitalism as the source of exploitation of one man by another.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Voline compared the Platform's centralised party to Bolshevism, and Faure notes Bolshevism destroyed the Nabat; anarchists reject any dictatorship.

collective-farming.rationale: Communist current pools means of production; the synthesis leaves forms free, so agreement is soft.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Faure sees capitalism as exploitative and authoritarian; inferred link to imperial war.

taxation-theft.rationale: Individualists call taxation theft while communists accept common contributions; no shared position.

harm-principle.rationale: Anarchists deny that the state has any legitimate authority to restrict, even on harm grounds; inferred.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Faure honours individual fulfilment but also social solidarity; split between individualist and communist currents.

conscription.rationale: Compulsory military service is a state authoritarian institution that Faure seeks to abolish.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Anarchists want both voluntary association and direct participation, rejecting exit as the main check; inferred.

state-as-business.rationale: Treating the state as a firm retains the state, which Faure wants abolished.

positive-liberty.rationale: Faure affirms every individual's right to complete fulfilment of needs, which requires material means.

media-academia-power.rationale: A conservative critique of elites not shared; anarchists see state and capital as the main powers.

organic-representation.rationale: Corporatist representation of families and trade bodies is hierarchical and statist; inferred.

total-state.rationale: Faure aims to abolish every authoritarian institution, and the state above all.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Imperial expansion requires a state, which Faure wants abolished.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Feudal lordship is an authoritarian institution of the kind Faure would abolish.

bound-labor.rationale: Compelled labour is exploitation of one by another, which Faure condemns.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; adherents vary.

universal-morality.rationale: Not discussed; anarchists range from rationalist to relativist views.

single-common-good.rationale: Voline rejects one current holding the sole truth and stresses diversity in equilibrium, so a single reasoned common good is doubted.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Anarchists oppose the creation of any state; the question of Jewish peoplehood itself is not addressed.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Return rights are not discussed; open borders sympathies pull one way, anti-nation-state views another.

revive-national-language.rationale: State-imposed language revival is a nation-state project; inferred.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Syndicalism is Voline's method of revolution, putting workers in control of workplaces, though anarchists would prefer self-management to democracy as vote.

school-vouchers.rationale: Neither state nor market schooling is anarchist ideal; inferred.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: State fiscal management is not an anarchist concern; sources silent.

economic-freedom.rationale: Faure ties individual fulfilment to economic emancipation, though meaning differs from market freedom.

rule-by-example.rationale: Voline says anarchists should guide by example, but anarchism rejects rulers altogether.

national-self-determination.rationale: Anarchists reject the nation-state form even where they support oppressed peoples.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Mainstream anarchism is secular and rationalist, though SEP notes religious anarchists.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Inferred from rejection of citizenship and borders.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Compulsion to work under state conditions contradicts the right to fulfilment of needs; inferred.

class-collaboration.rationale: Faure's Social Revolution is an assault on the capitalist order, and syndicalist method rests on class struggle.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Futurist destruction of culture is not an anarchist theme; inferred.

dominated-front.rationale: Not discussed; anarchists oppose Western imperial power but distrust state fronts.

workers-nation.rationale: The synthesis is internationalist, with revolution carried out by the masses everywhere, not on national lines.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Law that fixes roles is state coercion; inferred.

ban-interest.rationale: Mutualist strands favour it; communist and individualist currents differ.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: State-enforced domination is the opposite of anarchist principles.

state-class-instrument.rationale: SEP quotes Bakunin that where there is a state one class dominates another, a central anarchist thesis.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Eco-anarchist leanings and distrust of corporate extraction; inferred.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Inferred from rejection of nation-state cultural enforcement.

elite-replacement.rationale: Conspiracy claim not endorsed by anarchists; inferred.

proportional-representation.rationale: Electoral systems are irrelevant to or rejected by anarchists, who favour direct action over parliament.

national-mission.rationale: Spreading a state's form of government is the opposite of abolishing states.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: SEP notes anarchist critique of patriarchal hierarchy; sources on the synthesis are silent.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Anarchist view that authority corrupts; inferred.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Inferred from hostility to state violence.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Even a minimal state is an authoritarian institution to be abolished.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Inferred from equality in the anarchist ideal, though anarchists reject the framing through law.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Faure sees the Social Revolution as an assault on the world capitalist order; inferred internationalism.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Anarchists oppose state law in all forms; inferred.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Inferred from individual freedom of conscience.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: State bans on religious grounds are rejected; inferred.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Voline accused the Platform's centralisation of leading to a state, and anarchists reject a strengthened socialist state.

consent-of-governed.rationale: SEP discusses consent and unanimity as the only possible basis of legitimacy.

trade-surplus.rationale: Mercantilism is a state project; inferred.

population-transfer.rationale: Coercive expulsion is state authoritarianism opposed by Faure.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Faure endorses a brutal revolutionary assault, so a non-aggression absolutism is not shared.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Faure's communist current stresses pooling and cooperation; inferred.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Inferred from opposition to state repression.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Opposition to arbitrary power over others is the core of anarchism, per SEP's account of legitimacy.

separated-powers.rationale: Dividing state power still leaves a state; inferred.

vanguard-party.rationale: Voline says the masses, not anarchist groups, make the revolution, with anarchists as catalyst, against the Platform's party model.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Inferred from solidarity with the exploited.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Individual home ownership by state sale does not fit communist pooling; inferred.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Syndicalism, which Faure calls a lever of action, relies on strikes.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Faure traces want to capitalist exploitation, not population.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Rotation or lottery fits anti-professional politics, though anarchists reject offices.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Suspending protections is state coercion that Faure opposes.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: A state measure; the aim is abolition of the market for needs, not price caps.

party-controls-media.rationale: Party censorship is authoritarian, the opposite of the free anarchist press.

party-commands-army.rationale: Voline equated Platform party centralisation with Bolshevism; any army under party is rejected.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Inferred from rejection of border controls.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Anarchists reject representatives, but where delegates exist expect no privilege; inferred.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: The synthesis favours a loose heterogeneous federation preserving individual autonomy, against binding party discipline.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: A supranational union is still a state; inferred.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Concentrated executive command is authoritarian; Faure abolishes such institutions.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Hierarchical church government is authority; inferred.

clerical-rule.rationale: Rule by religious scholars is authoritarian, opposed by Faure.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Censorship conflicts with Faure's defence of freedom from mental oppression.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Entrenched office-holding conflicts with anarchist opposition to power; inferred.

recall-officials.rationale: Anarchists favour immediate accountability of delegates; inferred.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Communist current pools housing as a common good rather than ensuring each family owns it; inferred.

people-in-arms.rationale: Faure expects an armed insurrection of the masses; a standing army is rejected.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Not an anarchist theme; Kropotkin-style integration is not discussed in sources.

death-penalty.rationale: SEP reports anarchist critique of punishment as crime-breeding, and state killing is state violence.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Inferred from freedom of individual development.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Inferred from rejection of citizenship regimes.

minority-language-support.rationale: Inferred from support for autonomy of groups.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Anarchists reject general laws but doubt religious privilege; split.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Faure calls individualism the strongest reaction against mental oppression and affirms individual culture.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Faure holds that capitalist exploitation must be ended by social revolution, not just political change.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Anarchists prefer direct action over new state constitutions; inferred.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Faure's aim is liberation from authority; Bolshevik-style development dictatorship destroyed Nabat.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Inferred from solidarity, though state aid is not the means.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Weapons of the state are part of institutions to be abolished.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Electing a head of state still retains one; inferred.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Inferred from rejection of historic territorial claims by states.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Faure's pooling of the means of production implies property justified by common good.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Anarchists, including Voline, opposed Bolshevism as a new state; the exact label is not in sources opened.

collective-defense.rationale: Military alliances are state structures; inferred.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Anarchists reject the state but oppose annexation; sources silent.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Strengthening state authority over clergy conflicts with abolishing the state.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: A head of state is an authoritarian institution Faure seeks to abolish.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: The synthesis is a voluntary federation of autonomous members, excluding coercive union.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Pluralism of economic systems among communities is central to anarchism without adjectives, though joining a state is not.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Faure opposes every authoritarian institution, including sacred rulers.

flat-income-tax.rationale: State fiscal reform; the flat form favours the rich; inferred.

character-from-environment.rationale: Anarchists blame authority and conditions for social ills; inferred.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Unbound rulers are the extreme of authoritarian institutions.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Any constitution of rule is rejected; inferred.

leader-cult.rationale: Faure and Voline put the revolution in the hands of the masses, not leaders.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Voline warned that a centralised party would become a new state; the idea that leaders restore capitalism is close.

land-redistribution.rationale: Faure supports pooling production, which implies seizing large estates; form (division vs commons) is open.

refugee-return.rationale: Inferred from rejection of borders and expulsion.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Faure rejects mental oppression and authority; punishing belief is the opposite.

women-must-cover.rationale: State compulsion over personal life conflicts with individual fulfilment.

common-currency.rationale: Sources silent; currency is a state matter anarchists would abolish.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Inferred from support for voluntary association and autonomy.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Anarchists support struggle where one lives yet reject state rights as the aim; split.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Faure's account of exploitation and revolution is materialist in emphasis; not stated directly.

ban-cartels.rationale: State anti-trust leaves the state and capitalism in place; inferred.

no-bailouts.rationale: Anarchists oppose capital but also state support; split.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Anarchists reject majority power but also state courts; inferred.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: State quotas; anarchists want no such bodies.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Autarkic imperial bloc is statist; inferred.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Binding state treaties are statist but standards are welcome; split.

moral-incentives.rationale: Communist current expects social duty to replace incentives, individualists do not; split.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Voline holds the masses, not anarchist groups, make the revolution, with anarchists as catalyst.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Faure aims to abolish every authoritarian institution, including hereditary privilege.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Rule over others is authority; Faure opposes it.

patriotic-education.rationale: SEP notes anarchist scepticism toward the nation-state; indoctrination is rejected.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Inferred from opposition to racial inequality; state mechanism not discussed.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Faure expects an inevitable decisive assault on capitalism, suggesting it cannot adapt away.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Faure's solidarity of the working masses implies shared exploitation; inferred.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Individualist current may accept it, but communist current and egalitarian ethos do not; inferred.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: A constitutional court-enforced document still leaves the state in place; anarchists distrust it though they value the rights.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Inferred from anti-imperialism and rejection of state-imposed borders.

elective-rulers.rationale: Election beats inheritance but still installs rulers, which anarchists reject.

minority-veto.rationale: SEP notes anarchist attention to unanimity and consensus so that no one is bound without consent.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Faure calls for insurrection against the authoritarian order; resisting any ruler follows.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Parliament is a state institution Faure seeks to abolish, with direct action preferred to it.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Inferred from opposition to domination; not in the sources.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Sources silent; anarchists split between vegetarian and tolerant positions.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Paternal duty of the privileged presumes class hierarchy that Faure's revolution would end.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Voline stresses organised action as catalyst of the masses, not withdrawal.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Faure speaks of mental oppression; media as pacifier is inferred.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Anarchists hold that authority is maintained also by ideology; inferred.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Faure's critique of capitalist exploitation extends to world systems by inference.

native-born-offices.rationale: Inferred from rejection of nation-state citizenship.

party-own-road.rationale: Synthesis favours autonomy of member groups and rejects central direction from outside.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Sources silent; split between local self-reliance and international solidarity.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Anarchists reject political leadership by any group.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Faure notes fascism destroyed the Italian anarchist union; opposition to fascism is strong, though constitutions are not anarchist.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Faure names both fascism and Bolshevism as destroyers of the earlier anarchist unions, so both are condemned.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Inferred from anti-slavery and egalitarian stance.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Inferred from rejection of state glorification.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Anarchists reject any institutions of rule rather than adapt them.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Armed forces are an authoritarian institution to be abolished.

paid-care-work.rationale: Inferred from anti-capitalist recognition of unpaid labour.

filial-duty.rationale: Hierarchical family duty is doubted by anarchists; inferred.

office-by-exam.rationale: A bureaucratic elite is rejected; inferred.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: SEP notes anarchist view of love as liberated from law.

recallable-delegates.rationale: SEP's account of anarchist legitimacy centres on direct consent, implying delegates bound by those who send them.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Private financial products are capitalist; communist pooling preferred; inferred.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Parliamentary control still presumes a state; inferred.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Holding land by use rather than ownership is a common anarchist view; inferred.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Inferred from rejection of borders and land titles.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Anarchist critique of capitalist commodity culture; inferred.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Military domination by a state is the opposite of free federation.

corporate-influence.rationale: Faure attacks capitalism and authoritarian institutions, so corporate power over government is condemned.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: State suppression of civil society is rejected.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: State population engineering is rejected; inferred.

residents-only-property.rationale: Local restrictions on buying homes are exclusionary; inferred.

job-guarantee.rationale: A state employer of last resort keeps the state and wage labour.

democratic-peace.rationale: Spreading democracy abroad is a state project; inferred.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: SEP describes anarchism as a sceptical theory of political legitimation, with Wolff denying any general duty to obey.

non-intervention.rationale: States have no rights of intervention since they have no legitimacy; inferred.

industrial-unions.rationale: Syndicalism as a lever of action fits industrial organising; not discussed in detail.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Conspiracy claims against minorities are rejected; inferred.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: SEP cites arguments for liberating love from law.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Inferred from transparency against state secrecy.

local-production.rationale: Federated local communes fit local production; inferred.

informal-organisation.rationale: The synthesis seeks one heterogeneous but organised federation, in contrast to informal clusters, though loose.

religious-nation.rationale: SEP notes anarchist rejection of nation-states and political religion.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Sources silent; communist current favours sharing.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: The libertarian-communist current pools the means of production, not personal belongings; individualists protect possessions.

defeat-communism.rationale: Voline names communism as the organisational basis of the new society.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: State-funded mixed provision retains the state.

religion-illusion.rationale: Mainstream anarchism is atheist; SEP notes religious exceptions.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Faure treats capitalism as exploitative authoritarian order, not progress.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Faure ties emancipation to the end of capitalist exploitation; extension to women is inferred.

socialized-care.rationale: Communal provision of care is a common anarchist idea; inferred.

treaties-binding.rationale: Sources silent; anarchists doubt state treaties yet value agreements.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Small cooperative communities are among the experiments left open in anarchism without adjectives.

majority-settlement.rationale: Inferred from rejection of ethnic dominance.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Voline's Nabat takes communism as basis of the new society, so communism is not rejected.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: State punishment of private life conflicts with individual fulfilment.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Suppression is authoritarian; the anarchist movement itself was suppressed by Bolshevism and fascism.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Faure opposes mental oppression; state punishment of belief is rejected.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Exploitation of one by another is condemned by Faure.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Religious state war duties not part of the synthesis; inferred.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Inferred from rejection of religious rule.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Voline's synthesis relies on masses acting directly through free organisations and workplace syndicates.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Anarchist opposition to all domination; inferred.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: The synthesis combines left currents within anarchism and treats its place as against capital and state.

alienated-labor.rationale: Faure's critique of capitalist exploitation implies work estranged from its producers.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Inferred from universalism and opposition to prejudice.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Faure rejects every authoritarian institution, including claims of divine authority.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Anarchists reject the state but oppose clerical power; split.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Opposes abuse but relies on state law; split.

social-market-economy.rationale: Faure pursues pooling of the means of production, not a regulated market.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Faure abolishes authoritarian institutions such as the army, replacing them with armed masses in insurrection.

rich-first.rationale: Hierarchical development contradicts equality and solidarity.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Mutualist credit is among the options in anarchism without adjectives.

domination-women-nature.rationale: SEP notes eco-anarchist and social ecology links.

reification.rationale: Inferred from anticapitalist critique of commodity relations.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Faure's critique of capitalism implies the press is in capital's hands.

racial-franchise.rationale: Rule by a racial group is authoritarian.

online-participation.rationale: Direct participation by new means fits anarchism; inferred.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: State control of private life conflicts with individual fulfilment.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Persecution of a minority conflicts with egalitarianism and solidarity.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Direct deliberation resembles anarchist assemblies, though lot-based selection is not discussed.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Anarchists reject religion's authority, yet SEP notes Christian anarchists reinterpret; split.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Faure calls capitalism the source of exploitation and domination.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Anarchists oppose armies yet support equal liberty; genuinely split.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: State promotion of any belief is authoritarian.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: SEP reports Kropotkin's view of prisons as schools of crime; police belong to the state Faure abolishes.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Executive power-sharing keeps a state; inferred.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Mutual aid favours community help but communists criticise charity.

vote-delegation.rationale: Liquid delegation resembles recallable delegation but is untested in sources.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: The synthesis texts say nothing on extinction risk, and adherents would split on whether state policy is the right vehicle.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Anarchists reject hierarchy in marriage; SEP notes critique of patriarchal family.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Inferred from open borders and local participation.

rent-control.rationale: State remedy; anarchists favour communal housing; split.

abolish-ip.rationale: Pooling of means of production and exchange implies no monopoly of ideas; inferred.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Drilled state youth organisations are authoritarian.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Faure condemns exploitation of one man by another, i.e. income from ownership.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: SEP says Malatesta and Goldman defended violence against state violence; absolute pacifism is a minority religious strand.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Not addressed by the synthesis texts; adherents range from social-constructionist to biological views on sex.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; anarchists value individual self-definition but also organise around women's emancipation, so views split.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Nation-state martyrdom cult is rejected; inferred.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: The sources never address diaspora homelands; anarchists reject the state yet may value cultural centres, so they split.

culture-before-state.rationale: Not discussed by Faure or Voline; they would reject the state-building premise but may accept cultural renewal, so views split.

god-not-male.rationale: Religion is not addressed by the synthesis, and secular majority treat theology as irrelevant while religious anarchists would agree.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; most adherents reject scriptural authority outright, religious ones may agree, so no common answer.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Ethnic economic control is rejected; inferred.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: State boundary drawing for peoples; inferred.

independent-unions.rationale: Faure wants unions working toward anarchist ends, warning they become conservative; state or party control would defeat that.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Voline puts the revolution in the masses' own hands.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Communal control of water and hospitals fits federated communes, not state.

municipal-property.rationale: Communal ownership is one of the forms left open by anarchism without adjectives.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Synthesis organisation is a federation of autonomous groups with free technical coordination.

family-wage.rationale: The synthesis aims to abolish the wage system, so it has no stance on how large a wage should be; adherents split between rejecting wages and supporting fair ones.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Regulation of drugs is not addressed in the sources, and anarchists would distrust both state regulators and corporate drug makers.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Not addressed by the synthesis texts; state funding conflicts with anti-statism but the research aim is not opposed.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Inferred from distrust of state surveillance.

online-anonymity.rationale: Inferred from distrust of state surveillance.

person-over-state.rationale: Faure says individualism is the strongest reaction against oppression, with fulfilment of the individual as aim.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Mainstream anarchism is secular; SEP notes exceptions.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: The synthesis is built on free federation, not top-down grants of autonomy.

gm-crops.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; eco-anarchists oppose GM crops while others favour technology, so adherents are split.

dense-cities.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; eco-anarchist and communalist currents disagree on cities versus countryside.

racial-pride.rationale: Inferred from rejection of racial categories.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Anarchists oppose standing armies yet accept armed defence of revolution.

communal-electorates.rationale: Inferred from rejection of electoral politics.

free-public-college.rationale: Inferred from communism and free education.

pollution-taxes.rationale: State instrument, but ecological aim welcome.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; some anarchist feminists endorse such claims while others reject essentialism, so adherents split.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Inferred from transparency; state secrecy rejected.

capital-controls.rationale: State economic policy, not an anarchist tool.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Faure calls for armed insurrection against the state and army.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Syndicalist method fits unions bargaining, though anarchists prefer direct action.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Sources silent; anarchists reject state-led restructuring.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Faure holds the state and all institutions resulting from it must be abolished, not captured.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Voline rejects any current claiming sole truth and Faure presents communism, syndicalism and individualism as non-contradictory; anarchism without adjectives rejects blueprints.

sacred-nation.rationale: SEP reports anarchist rejection of nation-state.

internal-colonialism.rationale: The sources do not discuss regional exploitation within states; anarchists oppose domination but the colonial analogy is not part of the synthesis.

public-service-media.rationale: Sources silent; state funding conflicts with independence.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: State control of reproduction is an authoritarian intrusion on the individual's right to fulfilment that Faure affirms; not discussed directly.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Mainstream anarchism is secular and materialist about exploitation, though SEP notes religious anarchists who would partly agree.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Anarchists mostly reject religious authority and dogma; inferred from the general anarchist treatment of religion.

farm-price-support.rationale: Anarchists favour cooperative and communal agriculture but oppose state price guarantees; inferred.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Anarchists oppose states and armies, so a state keeping nuclear arms conflicts with their core; inferred.

workers-own-party.rationale: The synthesis rejects party politics and electoralism, relying on direct action and unions rather than a workers' party.

ban-fgm.rationale: Anarchists oppose the practice but also criminal law enforced by the state, so agreement with a legal ban is split; inferred.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Anarchists favour equality of the sexes but wish to abolish private inheritance itself, so the answer is a weak inference.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Not addressed; no basis in the sources.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Anarchist communists oppose a property-and-lawsuit regime in favour of communal management; inferred.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: The synthesis aims to abolish the state and every hierarchical authority, which excludes an official chiefs' role in lawmaking.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Anarchists prize liberty and reject coercive authority even for ecological ends, though many are ecologically minded; inferred.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Anarchists oppose the penal state and fixed state punishments, a position the sources attribute to general anarchism.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Anarchists reject borders and state compulsion over newcomers; inferred from general anarchism.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Inferred from the anarchist principle of free association, under which union membership is voluntary.

voter-id.rationale: Inferred from anarchist rejection of state electoral machinery and its control of who may participate.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Inferred from anarchist opposition to any state privileging one religious body; the state itself would be abolished.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Anarchists reject rule by elected rulers as still domination and demand direct self-management.

premarital-sex.rationale: Not addressed in the texts; inferred from the anarchist critique of marriage and traditional moral authority.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Faure and Voline reject state authority over the people, so state power to cut communications has no legitimacy.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Inferred; synthesists aim to abolish wage and welfare structures through social revolution, not to reform them into a state payment.

women-suffrage.rationale: Anarchists support equality of women but reject the state's voting and office-holding, so the statement fits poorly; inferred split.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Inferred from the anarchist critique of religious authority; the sources do not discuss gender.

race-social-construct.rationale: Inferred from anarchist opposition to hierarchy and nationalism; not discussed in the synthesis texts.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Inferred from anarchist rejection of state machinery, even for equality aims.

homestead-ownership.rationale: Inferred: individualist strands accept occupancy-and-use claims but anarchist communists reject property in land, and the synthesis leaves the economic form open, leaning against first-claim ownership.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Inferred: anarchists reject state courts and the states that would staff international ones, although they condemn atrocities.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Anarchists of the synthesis were atheist and anticlerical and rejected divine authority along with the state.

gendered-self-government.rationale: Inferred from general anarchist commitment to equality and anarcha-feminism; the texts do not address Indigenous self-government.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Voline's synthesis opposes the Bolshevik state model and any bureaucratic state, however nationalised.

indirect-election.rationale: Inferred: federations run on mandated delegates from below, but anarchists reject electing any higher office, so adherents split.

national-church-status.rationale: Abolishing the state and religious authority means no church can have a privileged legal status.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: Inferred from the federalist, anti-centralist outlook that favours local self-determination.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Inferred: anarchists reject state borders in principle and the texts do not discuss voting on territory.

keep-colonial-borders.rationale: Inferred: anarchists reject the state and its borders, so the choice between colonial and new borders is not theirs.

simple-living.rationale: Inferred: anarchist communists favour abundance while primitivist and individualist strands favour simplicity, so adherents are split.

restrict-indigenous-settlement.rationale: Inferred: the texts never address the question and anarchists reject both state restrictions and colonial settlement.

equal-conscription.rationale: Inferred from anarchist antimilitarism: conscription is rejected, so applying to neither fits.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: Anarchists reject the nation and the state; inferred from general anarchist internationalism, not from the synthesis texts.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Anarchism rejects state violence and punishment, and no tendency of the synthesis would license killing suspects without trial.

close-ties-china.rationale: Not addressed; anarchists oppose alliances of states with great powers, so the framing is rejected by inference.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: Not addressed; the synthesis rejects nation-states, so a state duty to co-nationals abroad is inferred to be rejected.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: The synthesis leaves the economic form open, but anarchist communism and mutualism treat land and resources as common, while individualists differ, so mild agreement is inferred.

self-ownership.rationale: The synthesis joins individualist anarchism with communism, so individual sovereignty is valued, but communists may contest the phrasing.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: Not addressed; anarchists reject taxation by the state as such, so a question about which taxes to cut barely applies.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Not addressed; anarchists reject state welfare administration, and the synthesis leaves economic form open.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Anarchists reject electoral parties but favour organised federated groups, so bypassing groups is inferred to be rejected, though the leader framing does not fit.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Anarchists oppose state favours to capital, but the framing presumes a state and the synthesis does not address it.

no-denominational-politics.rationale: Anarchism is secular and opposes organising power by religion, an inference from general anarchist principles.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: Not addressed; anarchists value progress and anti-traditional liberty, though anarcho-primitivists differ, so mild rejection is inferred.

wife-divorce-without-consent.rationale: Anarchism opposes patriarchal authority in marriage and favours free unions that either partner may end, as inferred from general anarchist principles.

national-resource-control.rationale: Anarchists reject state ownership, favouring common ownership by free communities, so national control is inferred to be rejected.

distribution-by-process.rationale: Anarchists hold that wealth built on property and wage exploitation is not made just by formally voluntary steps, so outcomes and origins both matter; inferred from general anarchist principles.

financial-transactions-tax.rationale: A tax is a state measure and the synthesis aims to abolish capitalism and the state, not regulate finance; inferred.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Anarchists see racism as one of several interlocked hierarchies still to be fought; inferred from general anarchist principles.

unjust-law-not-binding.rationale: Anarchists deny that state law carries inherent authority and put conscience and solidarity above it, though they do not argue in natural-law terms.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Faure's libertarian communism looks to abolishing wage labour and sharing abundance; automation is not discussed, so inferred.

multipolar-world.rationale: Anarchists oppose all states and great powers but favour federation of free communities; the question of power centres is not addressed and strands differ.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Anarchist communists and mutualists in the synthesis hold that labour is the source of wealth and that capital exploits it, but individualists differ; inferred.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Anarchists reject patriotism and borders as tools of state power and stress international working-class solidarity.

material-over-identity.rationale: The synthesis is pluralist and opposes every form of domination, so identity issues are not subordinated to economics; inferred.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Synthesists reject party rule and the state outright, and set the federated anarchist organisation against any party-led model.

missingStatements.text: Different schools within a political movement should unite in one organisation without requiring agreement on a single doctrine.
missingStatements.rationale: Faure and Voline make united organisation of distinct currents the defining demand of the synthesis, against the Platform's ideological unity.
missingStatements.declined: Organisational dispute internal to anarchism (synthesis versus Platform); too narrow for the bank.

missingStatements.text: A revolution should be carried out by the masses themselves, with political groups acting as a catalyst and example rather than as leaders.
missingStatements.rationale: Voline says the masses, not anarchist groups, make the revolution, with anarchists supplying cooperation, guidance and example.

notes: Statements outside the synthesis texts rest on inference from anarchist principles; pure individualist and anarcho-capitalist adherents would differ on economy and property statements.
